description: Rakuten Advertising conversion image on track.linksynergy.com/ep. Click redirects on click.linksynergy.com are not contracted.

params.name: mid
params.description: It is the numeric merchant ID. Generated `/ep` pixels send it. Rakuten documents tracking methods rather than this query, so the rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Set `mid` to the Merchant ID from Rakuten Advertising.

params.name: ord
params.description: It is the unique order ID. Generated `/ep` pixels send it.
params.fix_hint: Set `ord` to a unique order identifier.

params.name: skulist
params.description: It is the pipe-delimited SKU list generated pixels send for itemized orders.
params.fix_hint: Set `skulist` to the order SKUs, pipe-delimited when there is more than one item.
